text: 1、有空就想去多搬砖，好给孩子多加个鸡腿。
en: Whenever I have free time I want to do more graft, so I can put an extra chicken leg on the table for my child.

text: 2、每年都要体检，又害怕体检。
en: Every year I have to have a medical, yet I dread having one.

text: 怕家里人没了顶梁柱怎么活。
en: I'm afraid of how my family would cope if they lost their pillar of support.

text: 3、被上级骂，不会发怒，下属不听话，也生气不起来。
en: When scolded by my superiors I don't fly into a rage, and when subordinates won't listen I can't even get angry.

text: 4、夫妻是战友，共同抗起这个家。
en: Husband and wife are comrades-in-arms, jointly holding up this family.

text: 至于爱情，浪漫是什么东西？
en: As for love, what on earth is romance?

text: 5、基本上没有朋友。
en: I basically have no friends.

text: 曾经的发小，好久没联系。
en: The childhood friends I once had — I haven't been in touch for ages.

text: 拿起手机看了又看，算了！
en: I picked up my phone and looked at it again and again, then thought, forget it!

text: 6、害怕接到老家的电话。
en: I'm afraid of receiving calls from back home.

text: 未尽的责任，有心无力。
en: The responsibilities I haven't yet fulfilled — I have the heart but not the strength.

text: 7、越来越沉默。
en: Increasingly silent.

text: 稳重到自己都有点害怕。
en: So steady and composed that I even frighten myself.

text: 8、给自己带上面具和盔甲，就是不能，也不敢暴露软弱。
en: I put on a mask and armour for myself, simply unable, and not daring either, to expose any weakness.

text: 因为无可依靠。
en: Because there is nothing to rely on.

text: 9、难以入睡，睡眠很浅。
en: Hard to fall asleep; sleep is very light.

text: 经常半夜醒来，再也睡不着。
en: Often I wake in the middle of the night and cannot get back to sleep.

text: 10、白头发，再也不是一根一根的增加，而是一撮一撮的增加。
en: White hairs no longer appear one by one, but in clumps.

text: 40岁左。
en: Around 40.

text: 前两天查出甲状腺结节，说是很大可能恶性，有点焦虑。
en: The other day a thyroid nodule was found; they said it was very likely malignant, and I felt a little anxious.

text: 后来说可以治疗。
en: Later they said it could be treated.

text: 再前几天，媳妇查出白癜风，慢性病，需要长期治疗。
en: A few days before that, my wife was diagnosed with vitiligo, a chronic illness needing long-term treatment.

text: 疾病其实不至于摧垮我，但这两个病一得，治病买药，加上这个月搭了几个礼，房贷，然后我没钱了。
en: Illness itself wouldn't really break me, but once I had these two conditions, between the treatment and medicine, plus the few social gifts I had to give this month and the mortgage, I had no money left.

text: 而且由于下个月要请病假，房贷还是个问题。
en: And since I'll need to take sick leave next month, the mortgage is still a problem.

text: 体会是还得有积蓄，不然没法应对风险。
en: The lesson is that one must have savings, otherwise there's no way to cope with risk.

text: 其次是赶上什么病，有时候真的无了奈何。
en: Next, when struck by some illness, sometimes there's really nothing one can do.

text: 只能积极应对。
en: All I can do is respond positively.

text: 87年生人，马上就40了，北漂10年了，也没混出个名堂来。
en: Born in '87, about to turn 40, a Beijing drifter for ten years, and still haven't made anything of myself.

text: 说到家庭，地地道道农村子弟，父亲已经去世10年，母亲身体还行，在前些年赶上农村趸交养老保险，母亲交了一笔钱后，算是也拿上了退休金，不过每个月也只有400多一点，刚开始只有300多点，聊胜于无吧。
en: Speaking of family, I'm a true son of the countryside. My father died ten years ago; my mother is in reasonable health. Some years back she signed up for the rural lump-sum pension scheme — after paying a lump sum she too started drawing a pension, though it's only just over 400 a month; at first it was just over 300, but better than nothing.

text: 有了孩子之后，母亲就和我们一起北漂，反正一家人在一起就挺好的。
en: After we had a child, my mother came to Beijing with us as a drifter too; anyway, the family being together is just fine.

text: 老婆长我一岁，也是农村原生家庭，学的农业专业。
en: My wife is a year older than me, also from a rural birth family, and studied agriculture.

text: 结婚之后就在家里带了3年孩子，在17年初才又重新步入职场。
en: After we married she looked after the child at home for three years, and only re-entered the workforce at the start of 2017.

text: 后来赶上疫情，行业也不景气，到23年的时候，公司已经无法正常发工资了。
en: Later came the pandemic, and the industry was also in the doldrums; by 2023 the company could no longer pay wages normally.

text: 于是换工作，但是干的也不顺心，几个月后也离职了。
en: So she changed jobs, but wasn't happy in it either, and left after a few months.

text: 或许是年龄大了、行业也确实不景气，找了几个月也一直没找到，现在每个月领着2000块的失业金在家专职带孩子，但也只能领一年半。
en: Perhaps because she's older and the industry really is depressed, after job-hunting for several months she still hasn't found one; now she draws 2,000 yuan a month in unemployment benefit, looking after the child full-time at home, but can only receive it for a year and a half.

text: 我呢，也没什么大本事，来北京之后也换了几份工作，目前以劳务派遣形式在一家央企三级公司办公室工作，税前差不多30，单位有食堂，每年发衣服，福利也还好。
en: As for me, I don't have any great ability either; since coming to Beijing I've changed jobs a few times. Currently I work in the office of a third-tier subsidiary of a central state-owned enterprise, on a labour dispatch basis, roughly 30k before tax, with a canteen at the unit, get clothes issued every year, and the benefits are all right.

text: 尽管工作压力不算大，但自己依旧担心，算是部门比较年长的了，毕竟年龄在那摆着呢，但是合同到期不续签，走一步看一步吧！
en: Although the work pressure isn't great, I'm still worried; I'm among the older ones in the department — after all, the age is there for all to see — but if the contract isn't renewed when it ends, I'll just take things as they come!

text: 孩子上四年级了，是个男孩，学习一般，沉迷于游戏，最近算是强迫他把游戏断了，但就是不爱学习，也不学习，每天只要完成作业，就万事大吉了。
en: The child is in year four, a boy, average at his studies and addicted to games. Recently I more or less forced him to give up games, but he just doesn't like studying and won't study; as long as he finishes his homework each day, that's job done.

text: 给他报了英语学习班，结果上学期期末和本学期期中都考了C，反正就是不爱学习，头疼。
en: I enrolled him in an English study class, but he got a C in both last term's final exam and this term's mid-term; anyway he just doesn't like studying — what a headache.

text: 最近这两年明显感觉自己在快速衰老，在35岁之前，自己真的一根白头发都没有，但是这两年真的是在快速增长，每次照镜子，都不禁问自己，怎么变成了这个样子。
en: In the last two years I've clearly felt myself ageing rapidly. Before 35 I really didn't have a single white hair, but in these two years they've truly multiplied fast; every time I look in the mirror I can't help asking myself how I became like this.

text: 原来晚上是沾枕头就着，现在却经常失眠。
en: Before, I'd fall asleep the moment my head touched the pillow; now I often suffer from insomnia.

text: 尿个尿，也开始呲到自己身上了。
en: Even having a wee, I've started splashing it onto myself.

text: 现在的想法就是多存钱，害怕失业啊，上有老、下有小的，老婆也没工作。
en: My thinking now is just to save more money; I'm afraid of losing my job, with elderly above and children below to support, and my wife out of work too.

text: 不过老婆还算勤俭持家，每年都能存上一笔钱。
en: Still, my wife is fairly thrifty and manages the household well, and can put away a sum of money each year.

text: 然后就是孩子上学，因为没有户口，顶多在北京上到小学毕业，不过准备在六年级的时候就想把孩子转回去，提前适应一下，这样就剩一年了。
en: Then there's the child's schooling. Because he has no hukou, at most he can study in Beijing through primary school; but we're planning to transfer him back in year six to adapt early, which leaves just one year.

text: 接着就是自己了，孩子回去之后，北京也就剩我自己了，虽然离着老家不远，但毕竟就不在一起了。
en: Then there's myself. Once the child goes back, I'll be the only one left in Beijing; though it's not far from my hometown, we after all won't be together.

text: 回老家找工作，根本就没有什么机会，目前就只能还在北京漂啊！
en: Looking for work back in my hometown, there's basically no opportunity; for now I can only keep drifting in Beijing!

text: 因为公司是做海外业务的，想着是等母亲、老婆孩子回老家后就去国外项目干几年，多挣点钱回来，到时候人家不要了，回老家县城也有底气。
en: Because the company does overseas business, my thinking is that once my mother, wife and child return to our hometown, I'll go work on foreign projects for a few years to earn more, so that when they no longer want me I'll have some confidence returning to the county town.

text: 但是，老婆不愿意，说不能把老人孩子都抛给她，尤其是孩子，她这么多年来对他的溺爱，已经让孩子根本就不听她的话了，家里没人镇得住他，绝对不行。
en: But my wife won't hear of it, saying she can't be left alone with the elderly and the child; especially the child — her years of spoiling him have made him simply not listen to her, and there's no one at home who can keep him in line; absolutely not.

text: 唉，不知道是不是应该出去赚钱还是就守着老婆孩子，钱很重要，但孩子的教育和未来也很重要。
en: Sigh — I don't know whether I should go out to earn money or just stay with my wife and child. Money matters, but the child's education and future matter too.

text: 走一步看一步吧！
en: Take it one step at a time!

text: 38岁，妥妥中年，坐标帝都。
en: 38 years old, squarely middle-aged, based in the Imperial Capital.

text: 说到中年，去年以前，心里一直觉得自己还是28，从来没有过年龄焦虑。
en: Speaking of middle age, before last year I always felt I was still 28 in my heart, and never had any anxiety about age.

text: 也是因为比较瘦，所以看起来年龄比实际小一些。
en: Also, because I'm fairly slim, I look a bit younger than my actual age.

text: 大概就长这样。
en: Roughly, that's what I look like.

text: 也就是在今年，才真正有了年龄意识，知道自己不再年轻了。
en: It's only this year that I've truly become aware of age, knowing I'm no longer young.

text: 就挺秃然的。
en: It came rather abruptly.

text: 心里也终于有了那种中年的感觉。
en: And in my heart I finally have that middle-aged feeling.

text: 那究竟是一种什么样的感觉呢？
en: So just what kind of feeling is that?

text: 首先就是格外在意健康了。
en: First, I care about my health far more than before.

text: 因为明白自己的健康承载着整个家庭的未来，所以基本不熬夜，早睡早起。
en: Because I understand my health carries the future of the whole family, I basically don't stay up late, and go to bed and get up early.

text: 同时重新捡起了落灰多年的羽毛球拍，边找教练恢复边找球友开养生局。
en: At the same time I've picked up my badminton racket that had gathered dust for years, finding a coach to get back into form while looking for playing partners for gentle keep-fit sessions.

text: 以前卷天卷地落下的胃病肩颈病，也在用各种办法慢慢调理。
en: The stomach trouble and neck-and-shoulder complaints left by all that past relentless grinding are also being slowly nursed right through various methods.

text: 然后就是拒绝一切无效社交。
en: Then there's rejecting all pointless socialising.

text: 非必要的局不参加，非重要的人不想见。
en: I don't attend gatherings that aren't necessary, and don't want to see people who aren't important.

text: 圈子基本固定了，很难拉新人进来也不愿轻易加入新圈子。
en: My circle is basically fixed; it's hard to bring new people in, and I'm unwilling to easily join new circles.

text: 与其和一帮不熟的人尬聊，不如回家陪闺女弹琴看书写作业。
en: Rather than make awkward small talk with a bunch of people I don't know well, I'd rather go home and keep my daughter company — playing piano, reading, doing homework.

text: 还有就是越来越重视家庭。
en: Also, I value family more and more.

text: 到这个年龄，少说也在江湖上混了十几年，起起伏伏，人来人往经历了不少，终于发现，只有家才是永恒的港湾，家人是最坚强的后盾，是心底最温柔的角落。
en: At this age, I've at least knocked about in the world for over a decade, experienced plenty of ups and downs and comings and goings of people, and finally realised that only home is an eternal harbour, family the sturdiest backing, the gentlest corner of one's heart.

text: 我甚至发现，自己越发依赖老婆和闺女了。
en: I've even found myself increasingly reliant on my wife and daughter.

text: 心态也越来越持重稳定。
en: My state of mind is also ever more composed and steady.

text: 不能说所有事都能看的开，但大部分事情都能做到波澜不惊。
en: I can't say I take everything lightly, but for most things I can remain unruffled.

text: 最核心的原因就是能很快抓住问题本质，而且阅历和资源的积累能够很快找到解决办法，或者接受现实。
en: The core reason is that I can quickly grasp the essence of a problem, and with the accumulation of experience and resources I can promptly find a solution, or accept reality.

text: 也不再轻易发脾气头脑发热了。
en: I no longer lose my temper or get hot-headed easily.

text: 不再给自己设立不切实际的目标。
en: I no longer set myself unrealistic goals.

text: 并不是说没有理想不再拼了，而是承认自己是一个普通人，芸芸众生中的一员，一切目标都会围绕着稳定，持久，安全这几个核心，会去充分衡量得失，权衡性价比，“爱bia jia 会 赢”更属于十年前的自己。
en: It's not that I've no ideals and have stopped striving, but that I acknowledge I'm an ordinary person, one of the masses; all my goals revolve around the cores of stability, persistence and security, and I weigh gains and losses fully and balance cost-effectiveness. That old 'strive and you shall win' attitude belongs more to the person I was ten years ago.

text: 越来越喜欢独处、读书和写作
en: Increasingly I like being alone, reading and writing.

text: 年轻的时候把时间给了工作，给了事业中自己喜欢或不喜欢的人。
en: When I was young I gave my time to work, to people in my career I liked or didn't like.

text: 现在更希望把时间留给自己，把想读没读的书慢慢读完，把想说没说的话慢慢写出来，写到自己六七十岁之后，变成一本回忆录。
en: Now I'd rather keep my time for myself, slowly finish the books I wanted to read but never did, slowly write down the things I wanted to say but never said, writing until I'm in my sixties or seventies and turning it into a memoir.

text: 夫妻关系越来越理性和融洽
en: The husband-and-wife relationship is becoming ever more rational and harmonious.

text: 对感情越来越理性，深知两个人结合不仅仅靠的是荷尔蒙占领智商高地时的脑子一热，而是相互妥协相互协作。
en: I'm ever more rational about feelings, deeply aware that two people's union relies not merely on the hot-headed impulse when hormones occupy the high ground of reason, but on mutual compromise and cooperation.

text: 感情需要有，但理性更需要有。
en: Affection is needed, but rationality is needed even more.

text: 有问题要商量，没问题要交流，把家庭当某种形式的公司，把爱人当不可缺少的合伙人，有共同目标共同纲领，很多鸡毛蒜皮的问题就不再是问题。
en: When there's a problem we discuss it; when there isn't, we communicate; we treat the family as a kind of company and our spouse as an indispensable partner, with shared goals and a common charter, and many trivial matters cease to be problems.

text: 今年也遇到了一些波折，所以反思比较多，心态也就发生了突然的转变。
en: This year I also met with some setbacks, so I've reflected quite a lot, and my mindset underwent a sudden shift.

text: 两年之后正式不惑，再来看看是不是会有新的感悟。
en: Two years from now I'll formally reach forty — the age of 'no perplexity' — and see then whether I have new insights.
